caption:
Collector called? Say this. 📞

"Please send me written validation of this debt."

Then stay calm and keep your notes. Check your own situation and rights.

Have you ever dealt with a collector call?
first_comment: Ever had a collector call? What did you do? 👇
sources: pattern: if X happens, say this

card.headline: Collector calls? Say: "Send it in writing."
card.sub: Ask for written validation of the debt.
